factcheck.claim: Love Yourself: Tear made BTS the first K-pop act to top the U.S. albums chart in 2018.
Dynamite became the first K-pop track to reach 1 billion streams on Spotify.
Billboard announced on May 17 that ARIRANG spent its eighth consecutive week in the Billboard 200 top 10 at No. 8 and earned 44,000 equivalent album units for the week ending May 14.
ARIRANG debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, giving BTS its seventh No. 1 album, with 641,000 equivalent album units and 532,000 pure album sales.
The Billboard 200 ranks albums in the U.S. using equivalent album units including sales, TEA, and SEA.
